column1: What is something about getting older that has surprised you in a good way?
column2: When did you first notice it?

column1: What part of you feels exactly the same as it did when you were twenty?
column2: Why do you think that part has stayed so steady?

column1: What age do you feel like on the inside?
column2: What makes that age fit you?

column1: Who is an older person you have admired for the way they aged?
column2: What did they do that you would like to borrow?

column1: What do you understand now that you could not have understood ten years ago?
column2: What experience taught it to you?

column1: What are you looking forward to about your later years?
column2: What would help make that happen?

column1: What worries you most about growing older?
column2: What would make that worry feel lighter?

column1: How has your idea of being old changed over time?
column2: Who or what changed your mind?

column1: What is a birthday that felt especially meaningful to you?
column2: What made that one different from the rest?

column1: What would you tell your younger self about the years ahead?
column2: Which part would they most need to hear?

column1: What is something you have stopped caring about as you have gotten older?
column2: How has letting go of it changed your days?

column1: What is something you care about more now than you used to?
column2: What made it rise in importance?

column1: How do you want to spend an ordinary Tuesday when you are eighty?
column2: Who would you want to share that day with?

column1: What habit do you hope you will still have in twenty years?
column2: What does that habit give you now?

column1: What did your parents or grandparents teach you about growing older?
column2: How did they teach it through words or example?

column1: What is a skill you want to learn while you still have plenty of time?
column2: What has kept you from starting so far?

column1: How has your relationship with your body changed over the years?
column2: What do you appreciate about it now?

column1: What does a good old age look like to you?
column2: Which part of that picture matters most?

column1: What kind of older person do you hope people describe you as?
column2: What are you doing now that points in that direction?

column1: What is a piece of wisdom that came to you the hard way?
column2: How do you use it today?

column1: What do you think gets easier with age?
column2: When did you first feel it getting easier?

column1: What do you think gets harder with age?
column2: How do you hope to handle it when it comes?

column1: What would you like to be doing for fun when you are seventy-five?
column2: What would it take to keep that possible?

column1: How do you feel about being called wise someday?
column2: What would you want that wisdom to be about?

column1: What is a memory you hope you never forget?
column2: What details of it do you treasure most?

column1: What is something younger people could teach you?
column2: Who has taught you something like that recently?

column1: What is something you hope younger people learn from your generation?
column2: What story would you tell to explain it?

column1: How has your sense of time changed as you have gotten older?
column2: What do you do differently because of it?

column1: What is a decade of your life you would describe as your favorite so far?
column2: What made those years stand out?

column1: What do you hope your friendships look like in your later years?
column2: What are you doing now to tend them?

column1: Where would you love to live when you are older?
column2: What draws you to that kind of place?

column1: What is something you were afraid of when you were younger that no longer scares you?
column2: What helped you move past it?

column1: How do you want to handle changes to your health as you age?
column2: Who would you want by your side for that?

column1: What does retirement mean to you?
column2: What would make it feel full rather than empty?

column1: What role do you hope to play in the lives of younger family members later on?
column2: What did an older relative do for you that you would like to pass along?

column1: What is a song or movie that makes you feel your age?
column2: What does it bring back for you?

column1: What is something you want to do before you feel too old to do it?
column2: What would be a first step toward it?

column1: How do you feel when you look at old photos of yourself?
column2: What would you say to the person in those pictures?

column1: What has aging taught you about patience?
column2: Where do you see that patience show up now?

column1: What is one thing you hope stays the same about you no matter how old you get?
column2: Why does that part of you matter so much?

column1: What do you think is the secret to staying curious as you age?
column2: Who do you know that seems to have that secret?

column1: How has your idea of beauty changed with time?
column2: What do you find beautiful now that you once overlooked?

column1: What would you like to be known for in your neighborhood when you are older?
column2: What small thing could start that today?

column1: What does slowing down mean to you?
column2: Where in your life would slowing down feel like a gift?

column1: What is something you used to rush through that you now savor?
column2: What made you start noticing it?

column1: How do you hope to stay connected to the world as things keep changing?
column2: Which changes do you find most interesting?

column1: What has gotten better in your life with each passing year?
column2: What do you credit for that?

column1: What does it mean to you to grow old gracefully?
column2: What would you add to that phrase or push back on?

column1: What kind of grandparent or elder do you imagine being?
column2: What would you want the kids around you to remember?

column1: What would make you feel proud looking back from the age of ninety?
column2: What can you do this year that would add to that pride?

column1: What is a conversation you want to have with someone before you both get older?
column2: What makes it feel important to have it soon?

column1: What are you most grateful for about the age you are right now?
column2: How would you like to celebrate it?
